description: This Dart source file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application. It displays a searchable grid of folder items with functionality to create new folders, add documents, and lock the app. The widget manages state, handles user interactions, and interfaces with various services and repositories to load and modify folder and document data.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the list of folders, search bar, and floating action button for creating folders or adding documents.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the internal logic, data loading, and user interactions for HomeScreen.

classes.name: _FabMenu
classes.description: A custom widget implementing a popup menu attached to the floating action button, offering options to create a folder or add documents.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and loads folder data on widget creation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of controllers and resources when the widget is removed.

methods.name: _initializeAndLoad
methods.description: Sets up the folder repository and loads folders asynchronously.

methods.name: _loadFolders
methods.description: Fetches folders from the repository, optionally filtered by search query.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Updates search query and reloads folder list.

methods.name: _onCreateFolderPressed
methods.description: Prompts user to input folder name and creates a new folder.

methods.name: _onAddDocumentsPressed
methods.description: Allows user to pick files and adds them as uncategorized documents.

methods.name: _promptForFolderName
methods.description: Shows a dialog to input a new folder name.

methods.name: _onTapFolder
methods.description: Navigates to folder details based on selected folder.

methods.name: _onLockPressed
methods.description: Locks the application and navigates to the lock screen.
